data.general: With the Sun and Jupiter in your Rashi, you may experience increased confidence and a sense of purpose. However, the Moon in your 7th house indicates a need for emotional balance in your relationships. Mars in your 11th house suggests that you may be restless and seeking adventure.
data.luck: Your luck may be influenced by the position of the Moon in Capricorn, which can bring stability but also a sense of responsibility. Mars in Taurus can bring good fortune in your financial pursuits, but you may need to work hard to achieve your goals.
data.scope: The Sun and Jupiter in your Rashi indicate that your scope of vision is expanding, and you may be able to see new opportunities. However, Saturn in your 9th house suggests that you may need to be patient and persistent in order to achieve your goals.
data.study: With Mercury in your 12th house, you may be inclined towards spiritual or philosophical studies. The position of Rahu in your 8th house suggests that you may be drawn to unconventional or unorthodox ideas.
data.love: The Moon in your 7th house indicates that you may be focusing on your relationships and emotional needs. Venus in your 2nd house suggests that you may be valuing material security and stability in your love life.
data.travel: Saturn in your 9th house suggests that you may be hesitant to take risks when it comes to travel. However, the position of Jupiter in your Rashi can indicate a desire for exploration and adventure.
